decision.rationale: I checked the time limit first. TXN-007961 posted on 2026-09-02 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-23, 51 days later. That is within the 120-day limit (time-limits). The posted amount is 25841 cents (258.41 EUR), and the authorisation AUTH-008164 is for the same 25841 cents, so the two agree. The merchant is a TRAVEL merchant, so the restaurant tip rule does not apply. No receipt or quote is attached. The cardholder says the quote was 167.97 EUR, which would put 9044 cents (90.44 EUR) in dispute, but the cardholder does not have the quote, and an amount the cardholder states is a claim, not a receipt. With no receipt and the posted amount equal to the authorised amount, nothing in the records shows a different agreed amount. Under amount-no-receipt, the next step is to ask the merchant for the receipt or order details.

proposed_actions.note: Please provide the receipt or order details, including any quote, for the 258.41 EUR transaction made on 2026-09-01. They should show the amount the cardholder agreed to pay.
